episodes.title: Inside The Cult Of A Man Who Thinks He’s Jesus | FULL DOC | PURE DECLASSIFIED
episodes.description:
Deep in the Siberian taiga, thousands of people have built an isolated community around Vissarion, a former police officer turned spiritual leader. His followers live by strict rules and look to “The Teacher” for answers about life, faith and the future. Inside the Church of the Last 

Testament, beliefs about Armageddon, extraterrestrial life and divine revelation collide with an apparently peaceful way of life. The journey ends with a rare face-to-face interview with the man at the center of it all. 

Documentary: Vice Siberian Cult Leader Thinks He'S Jesus
Direction: Lise Lavallée
Production: Vice Media (2011)

episodes.title: Cult Witness: How People Become Trapped in Cults | FULL DOC | PURE DECLASSIFIED
episodes.description:
At 19, Samuel Stefan was drawn into a cult while struggling with a personal crisis. It would take him ten years to escape.

Through firsthand accounts from six former cult members, Cult Witness explores how cults recruit, manipulate and control their followers. Using techniques such as “love-bombing”, they can create intense bonds of trust before gradually isolating members and exerting psychological control.

Samuel Stefan recounts his own experience, including the violence he faced before finally escaping in the middle of the night. Other survivors share their experiences of life inside groups such as the Exclusive Brethren, the Gentle Wind Project, the Janus Project and the Children of God. Experts in leadership, sociology, psychology, social influence and law provide further insight into the mechanisms of cult control — and why vulnerable people can become trapped in them.

Documentary: Cult Witness
Direction: Samuel Stefan
Production: Arthio Productions, Sideways Film (2010)
